set.acceptance: A Go test in internal/ciworkflow (go test -trimpath ./internal/ciworkflow/...) parses .github/workflows/ci.yml and asserts the jobs and matrices above, strategy.fail-fast false on each matrix, setup-go with cache on and cache-dependency-path go.sum in every job, each job's run step calling make, and a job named check with needs on every other job, if: always() and a step failing unless changes succeeded and every other needed result is success or skipped (as ci-model-only-pr allows), and failing when none ran; the existing ci-yml triggers and concurrency checks still pass. The change set's own PR CI run completes in about 5 minutes or less, read from gh run view.
set.statement: CI runs the suite as parallel jobs of one workflow: lint, a matrix of 4 script shards, a matrix of 2 internal/api shards, rest and budgets, each calling its make target with fail-fast off and actions/setup-go caching modules and the build cache keyed on go.sum, on every run except a pull request whose changed paths all lie under .rhiza/, which skips them and runs only the model job (ci-model-only-pr); an aggregate job named check needs every other job (changes, model and the Go jobs), runs if: always() and fails unless changes succeeded and every other needed job succeeded or was skipped, with at least one of them succeeded; a PR's CI gives its verdict in about 5 minutes.
